map.输入粮温、粮仓湿度与粮种类型，综合判断储粮虫害爆发风险等级并给出处置建议: Enter the grain temperature, silo humidity, and grain type to judge the storage pest outbreak risk level and recommend actions
map.综合风险 = 温度分 × 0.45 + 湿度分 × 0.40 + 水分分 × 0: Overall risk = temperature score × 0.45 + humidity score × 0.40 + moisture score × 0.15; grain temperature > 25 °C with humidity > 70% is judged high risk
map.温度分按粮温分档（&lt;15℃ 10 分，15~20℃ 25 分，20~25℃: The temperature score is tiered by grain temperature (<15 °C → 10, 15–20 °C → 25, 20–25 °C → 50, 25–30 °C → 75, >30 °C → 95); the humidity score is tiered by silo relative humidity; the moisture score is based on the safe moisture content for the grain type, increasing as it goes above safe. A weighted total sets the level; if grain moisture exceeds the safe value by more than 1 percentage point, the level is raised one step even when temperature and humidity are mild.

map.多数储粮害虫 15℃ 以下停滞、25~35℃ 高发。: Most storage pests stall below 15 °C and peak between 25–35 °C.

Ventilate and cool below 20 °C immediately, measure the insect density, and fumigate with aluminium phosphide if needed (strictly per protocol).
map.温度阈值为什么因虫而异？: Why Do Temperature Thresholds Vary by Pest?
map.每种害虫有发育起点温度和最适温，如玉米象适 27~30℃、米象稍低。预警需先知道: Each pest has its own developmental threshold and optimum, such as the maize weevil at 27–30 °C and the rice weevil slightly lower. Alerts require knowing the main species, so one threshold cannot fit all.
map.预警后只能熏蒸吗？: Is Fumigation the Only Option After an Alert?
map.优先物理（降温、降湿、过筛），化学熏蒸是最后手段且需专业与防护。预防（清仓、压盖: Physical measures (cooling, dehumidifying, sieving) come first; chemical fumigation is a last resort requiring professionals and protection. Prevention (emptying, sealing, temperature control) beats treating after an outbreak.
